title: About
text:
My name is Arvind Kalyan.
I have spent the last year in Qualcomm’s Wireless Research Department, where we build the 6G user experience.
Previously, I graduated from UCLA with a BS and MS in Computer Science and a minor in bioinformatics. I worked in the Sankararaman Lab to complete my Master’s Thesis on structured missingness.
I’m most proud of my work with Bruin Sports Analytics, where I was president and led the football consulting team. We worked with the football coaching staff to develop a scouting tool to aid their mid-week opponent preparation.
My research interests lie in post-training algorithms and imputation methods. Broadly, I am fascinated by the applications of these paradigms in bioinformatics. This blog exists to prove that.
